title Authentication Service — System Design Document

' Artifact type: design

' ─── COMPONENT DIAGRAM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
page_ref: puml:title Authentication Service — System Design Document

content:
package "Authentication Service" {
  component [AuthController] as AuthCtrl
  component [TokenService] as TokenSvc
  component [PasswordHasher] as Hasher
  component [SessionManager] as SessionMgr
  interface "REST API" as RestAPI
}

package "External Services" {
  component [EmailService\n(SMTP)] as Email
  component [OTPProvider\n(TOTP)] as OTP
}

Browser --> HTTPS
Mobile --> HTTPS
HTTPS --> RateLimiter
RateLimiter --> Router
Router --> RestAPI
RestAPI --> AuthCtrl
AuthCtrl --> TokenSvc
AuthCtrl --> Hasher
AuthCtrl --> SessionMgr
AuthCtrl --> Email
AuthCtrl --> OTP
TokenSvc --> SessionStore
SessionMgr --> SessionStore
Hasher --> UserDB
AuthCtrl --> AuditDB

' ─── CLASS DIAGRAM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class User {
  - userId: UUID
  - email: String
  - passwordHash: String
  - salt: String
  - mfaEnabled: Boolean
  - accountStatus: AccountStatus
  - createdAt: Timestamp
  - lastLoginAt: Timestamp
  + validateCredentials(password: String): Boolean
  + enableMFA(): void
  + lockAccount(): void
}

class Session {
  - sessionId: UUID
  - userId: UUID
  - accessToken: String
  - refreshToken: String
  - expiresAt: Timestamp
  - ipAddress: String
  - userAgent: String
  + isExpired(): Boolean
  + refresh(): Session
  + invalidate(): void
}

class AuthRequest {
  - email: String
  - password: String
  - mfaCode: Optional<String>
  - clientIp: String
  + validate(): ValidationResult
}

class AuditEvent {
  - eventId: UUID
  - userId: UUID
  - eventType: EventType
  - timestamp: Timestamp
  - ipAddress: String
  - success: Boolean
  - failureReason: Optional<String>
}

enum EventType {
  LOGIN_SUCCESS
  LOGIN_FAILURE
  PASSWORD_CHANGE
  MFA_ENABLED
  ACCOUNT_LOCKED
  TOKEN_REFRESH
  LOGOUT
}

User "1" --> "0..*" Session : has
User "1" --> "0..*" AuditEvent : generates
AuthRequest --> AuthResponse : produces
Session --> AuditEvent : logged by

' ─── SEQUENCE DIAGRAM — Login Flow ─────────────────────────────────────────

actor Client
participant AuthController
participant PasswordHasher
participant UserDB
participant TokenService
participant SessionStore
participant AuditLog

Client -> AuthController : POST /auth/login {email, password}
AuthController -> AuthController : validate(AuthRequest)
AuthController -> UserDB : findByEmail(email)
UserDB --> AuthController : User | null

alt User not found
  AuthController -> AuditLog : log(LOGIN_FAILURE, "user_not_found")
  AuthController --> Client : 401 Unauthorized
else User found
  AuthController -> PasswordHasher : verify(password, user.passwordHash)
  PasswordHasher --> AuthController : Boolean

  alt Password invalid
    AuthController -> AuditLog : log(LOGIN_FAILURE, "invalid_password")
    AuthController -> UserDB : incrementFailedAttempts(userId)
    AuthController --> Client : 401 Unauthorized
  else Password valid
    opt MFA enabled
      AuthController -> Client : 200 {mfa_required: true}
      Client -> AuthController : POST /auth/mfa {mfaCode}
      AuthController -> AuthController : verifyTOTP(mfaCode)
    end
    AuthController -> TokenService : generateTokenPair(userId)
    TokenService --> AuthController : {accessToken, refreshToken}
    AuthController -> SessionStore : store(Session)
    AuthController -> AuditLog : log(LOGIN_SUCCESS)
    AuthController --> Client : 200 AuthResponse
  end
end

' ─── CONSTRAINTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

note as Constraints
  NFR Constraints:
  - Access token TTL: 15 minutes
  - Refresh token TTL: 7 days
  - Max failed login attempts: 5 before lock
  - Account lock duration: 30 minutes
  - Password minimum length: 12 characters
  - Password must contain: uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol
  - Rate limit: 10 login attempts per minute per IP
  - Session store TTL: aligned with refresh token TTL
  - All tokens must be signed with RS256 (asymmetric)
  - Audit log retention: 90 days
  - TLS 1.2 minimum for all connections
end note

@enduml
